headline: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
context: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.
